from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted for a single company from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company as reported in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock exchange code of the company, if available")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Financial reporting period covered in the document")
    total_operating_costs: float | None = Field(description="Total Operating Costs (营业总成本) for the period, absolute value")
    financial_expenses: float | None = Field(description="Financial Expenses (财务费用) for the period, signed value")
    source_doc_index: int | None = Field(description="The sequential index of the document this data came from, for conflict resolution")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyFinancialData]
